title: Digitally deliverable services are growing fast
discussion_signal: UNCTAD highlights rapid growth in digitally deliverable services while noting that least developed countries are not keeping pace and their share of global services exports is falling. The signal connects digital trade participation to infrastructure, capability, and unequal distribution of gains.
linked_research_question: How do digital infrastructure and productive capacity determine who participates in and benefits from cross-border services trade?
limits: Institutional summary of aggregate trade figures
No country-specific causal analysis in the post
Social engagement does not establish how firms or workers experience the distribution
